title: LatchAgentModelCatalogV2
description: Models one hosted agent can start with on the gateway host, read fresh from that agent's own model cache on each request and falling back to a list bundled with Latch when the cache is missing or unreadable.

models.description: Newest and most recommended first, in the order the agent itself lists them.

defaultModel.description: The model the agent starts with when creation names none: the owner's own configured choice on the Mac, which may be an alias outside `models`. Null when the Mac names none.
